viewing_check: Estimate 120-220, current bid $70. Check bass button count and model plate, whether all reeds sound, bellows leak and bass mechanism work, straps and case. Sold prices mostly $830-1,660 for working 120 bass units; the $115 and $100-140 sales were unplayable or small. Most sales within 3 years, prices steady.
